Container.Name: mediaexplorer
Container.Overview:
MediaExplorer — hierarchical image/video browser for big libraries.
Mount any number of shares at /media1..media8 (read-write: the .mxthumbs thumbnail store is written beside the media; a read-only share still works and falls back to the data path) and each mounted dir becomes a browsable location.
Rename a location with the MEDIA_N_NAME variable. Index and central packs live in the data path.
UI: http://[IP]:[PORT:8000]/

Config.Name: APP_NAME
Config.Description: Name shown in the app title bar

Config.Name: media1
Config.Description: Media share 1 (browsable location; read-write so thumbnails can be stored beside the media)

Config.Name: MX_PACK_MODE
Config.Description: adjacent = thumbnail store beside the media; central = under the data path
Config.Help: adjacent travels with the media and its backup. central writes nothing into the media tree (use it for a read-only mount or a test instance).

Config.Name: MX_WIPE_ON_BUILD
Config.Description: 1 = wipe every thumbnail when the app version changes (dev builds); 0 = keep the cache
Config.Help: 0 is the right answer once a real library is in use. Also switchable at runtime: POST /api/admin/settings {"wipe_on_build": false}.

Config.Name: MX_THUMB_WORKERS
Config.Description: Thumbnail encode threads; 0 = auto from the container's CPU allowance
Config.Help: Raise for faster big-folder builds; lower if it competes with ffmpeg or other containers.

Config.Name: MX_HWACCEL
Config.Description: Video decode: auto / cuda (NVDEC, needs --gpus all) / none
Config.Help: GPU users: set Extra Parameters to --gpus all and NVIDIA_DRIVER_CAPABILITIES=all (NVDEC needs the video capability).

Config.Name: NVIDIA_DRIVER_CAPABILITIES
Config.Description: Only for GPU decode: set to all alongside --gpus all
Config.Help: Without the video capability ffmpeg reports: No device available for decoder.

Config.Name: MX_ANIM_MAX
Config.Description: Max videos per scan that pre-build hover filmstrips (0-500)
Config.Help: Lower = faster scans on huge folders; filmstrips still build on hover.

Config.Name: MX_RESTART_TOKEN
Config.Help: Leave empty to keep the admin endpoints disabled.

Config.Name: Password protect
Config.Description: 1 = ask for a password before the library loads (0 = open)
Config.Help: Casual lock, not a security boundary: one shared password, remembered in a browser cookie for 30 days.

Config.Name: Password
Config.Description: Password asked for when Password protect is 1
Config.Help: Changing it signs every browser out. Stored as a salted hash, never in plain text.
